name: Lüdenscheid (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Lüdenscheid (a bishop on yellow above a red and white chequy wall).
history: Municipal flag of Lüdenscheid; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lüdenscheid arms — bishop above chequy wall
